mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals strengthening supply-side conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investor sentiment improves.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL below 2% YoY) coupled with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1%) signals accommodative monetary conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL is below 2% YoY and FEDFUNDS is below 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% within a month signals strengthening labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and corporate earnings are expected to improve.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in a month signals strengthening demand-side conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investor sentiment improves.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increases by more than 10% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real final sales (RSAFS) over two consecutive months signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to improve.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS increases for two consecutive months.
